faq_a1: Zaldemy is a language-learning app. You choose a native language and a language you want to learn, organize content into decks and phrases, and practice with different training modes while tracking your progress over time.
faq_q2: How do I choose the language I want to learn?
faq_a2: Right after signing up, you choose your native language and your learning language. You can change the language you're learning at any time using the selector at the top of the home screen.
faq_q3: How do I create my own decks and phrases?
faq_a3: On the home screen, tap "Add deck" to create a new deck. Then just open it to add the phrases you want to practice.
faq_q4: Can I share my decks with other people?
faq_a4: Yes. When creating or editing a deck, there's a "Share deck" option — when enabled, it becomes publicly available for other users to practice too.
faq_a5: You can practice by typing the translation of the phrase, in flashcard format (flip the card to see the answer), in guess mode, or using AI training. Each deck shows how many phrases are in learning, repeat, and review.
faq_q6: How does the phrase audio work?
faq_a6: The app automatically generates pronunciation audio for phrases in both your native and learning languages. You can also play the audio manually using the "Listen" button during training.
faq_a7: The app can be installed on your phone, and some core screens, like the home screen and flashcards, keep working even without a connection. Actions that depend on the server, like saving new content, require internet.
faq_a8: The Premium Plan unlocks extra features, like AI training. When you try to use a premium feature without an active plan, the app shows you the subscription options.
faq_q9: Can I sign in with my Google account?
faq_a9: Yes, you can sign in and sign up using your Google account, in addition to the regular email and password login.
faq_q10: I forgot my password, what do I do?
faq_a10: On the login screen, tap "Forgot my password" to receive reset instructions by email.
faq_q11: How do I track my progress?
faq_a11: On the Metrics screen you'll find your training stats, such as correct and incorrect answers and the number of words practiced in each deck.
faq_q12: How do I delete my account or ask other questions?
faq_a12: Reach out through the Contact page, available in the side menu, or directly by email at adm@zaldemy.com.
